purpose: Exercise the indexed optional renderer with a genuinely affine Type payload and check that the projector returned owner is retained by the outer array.
payloadType: AffineProbe is Type and owns Array<U32> cells; the test does not instantiate P with Data.
projector: mutate reads cells[0], writes cells[0]+100, increments serial, and returns the updated AffineProbe together with its Doc.
ownerObservation: The output includes the helper Doc and a second structural traversal of the helper-returned array with an identity renderer. Both must show first=105 and serial=4; the second line observes the actual returned owner.
expectedDerivation: The helper visits the Some leaf once, wraps the projector Doc as leaf:some(...), preserves NoneLeaf for the second slot, and builds the two-slot root as node(left,right). The returned outer array is re-rendered using the mutated AffineProbe.
baseBenchmarkFreeze: MOTION-INDEXED-OPTIONAL-SOURCE-FREEZE.json; benchmark source and runtime inputs remain unchanged.
limitations: This is a small direct helper control, not an ECS benchmark or proof of performance. No JS/native consumer has been run against this expected text yet.
